# Teyezilla Expeditions

> Teyezilla Expeditions is a premium African travel company offering tailor-made
> safaris, beach holidays, cultural tours, and desert expeditions across Africa.

## Destinations (open for booking)
- Kenya — Maasai Mara safaris, Amboseli, Nairobi city and food tours, Mount Kenya
- Tanzania — Serengeti safaris, Ngorongoro Crater, Mount Kilimanjaro treks
- Zanzibar — Stone Town, Mnemba Island, beach holidays
- Egypt — Pyramids of Giza, Nile cruises, Luxor
- Morocco — Marrakech, Chefchaouen, Sahara desert tours

## Destinations (coming soon)
Rwanda, Uganda, South Africa, Botswana, Zambia, Zimbabwe

## Tour categories
Safaris, beach holidays, cultural tours, city tours, food tours, desert expeditions,
tailor-made trips built with an AI trip planner.

## Booking
Tours can be booked online with a deposit or full payment (Stripe, M-Pesa, PayPal,
bank transfer) or by contacting the team directly on WhatsApp.
